items.summary: The ballot statement PDF could not be opened; a search-engine summary of it reports that a District 11 statement credits its author, the budget chair, with fully funding Free City College. Record: DCYF's reduction list for the mayor's proposal shows the City College Enrollment Assistance Fund line at $9,300,000 in FY2025–26 and $6,482,137 proposed for FY2026–27; Mission Local reported the proposal kept tuition aid and cut cash grants for low-income students. The Board's spending plan, item 1, "Full funding for Free City College", added $2.8 million in each of FY2026–27 and FY2027–28. The Budget and Appropriations Committee, on a motion by Chair Chan, recommended the amended budget 5–0 on June 25, 2026; the Board passed it 11–0 on July 28 and the mayor approved it July 30 (File 260596).
